mechanism_narrative: Four consecutive weekly increases in TRANSIT and GROCERY_PHARM mark monotone re-engagement with non-residential activity; this momentum carries into discretionary shopping, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT weekly mean rose from -44.4 to -41.3 and GROCERY_PHARM from -4.4 to -2.4 between t-3w and t-0w
failure_condition: The next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is at or below the last-28-day mean despite TRANSIT and GROCERY_PHARM both rising in every one of the four snapshot weeks.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS crossing above +25 marks a shift from distanced solo outdoor activity to bundled leisure outings; bundled trips include high-street errands, so the crossing lifts RETAIL_REC within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean crosses above +25 percent from below +25 percent
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from 9.3 at t-3w to 26.7 at t-0w, crossing +25 only in the final week
regime_hint: loosening outdoor-leisure regime with PARKS above baseline
failure_condition: In the 28 days after PARKS first exceeds +25, the mean of RETAIL_REC is not higher than its mean over the preceding 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Transit demand recovering while WORKPLACES does not means new transit trips are discretionary rather than commuting; discretionary transit trips terminate at retail-and-recreation destinations, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT week-on-week change is positive while WORKPLACES week-on-week change is zero or negative
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved +3.1 points over four weeks while WORKPLACES fell 1.0 point to -32.6
regime_hint: elevated work-from-home regime with workplace mobility flat or falling
failure_condition: Whenever TRANSIT rises while WORKPLACES is flat or falling, the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is lower than the preceding 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT pinned below -40 for four straight weeks identifies a binding stringency plateau; the retail ceiling implied by that plateau is already near, so the +0.4-point weekly crawl stalls and the next four weeks average no higher than the last four.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean stays below -40 for four consecutive snapshot weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT has remained between -44.4 and -41.3 across all four snapshot weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises by more than 1.0 point, measured as next-28-day mean minus last-28-day mean, while TRANSIT remains below -40.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL holding near +9.6 for four weeks is a sticky home-centred routine that reallocates time away from discretionary shopping trips; because the routine is not decaying, RETAIL_REC stays below its recent level over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean stays at or above +9.0 for four consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL has stayed within 9.0-10.1 for all four snapshot weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL remains at or above +9.0 while the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC exceeds the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The 17.4-point climb in PARKS from t-3w to t-0w is a lengthening-day seasonal signal; the same seasonal force raises all out-of-home leisure including retail-and-recreation visits, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS gained 17.4 points over the four snapshot weeks while RETAIL_REC gained 2.2
regime_hint: spring seasonal transition with PARKS rising
failure_condition: PARKS continues to rise week-on-week while the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is lower than the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM closing to within 3 points of its baseline is the earliest policy-de-escalation marker; grocery normalisation leads discretionary retail normalisation by two to three weeks, so RETAIL_REC rises over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean rises above -3.0 percent
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM reached -2.4 at t-0w, its closest value to baseline in the snapshot, while TRANSIT stayed near -41
regime_hint: policy de-escalation with essential-trip mobility near baseline
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM remains above -3.0 for the next two weeks yet the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC does not exceed the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES falling to its four-week low of -32.6 while TRANSIT rises indicates commuter trips are being replaced by non-commuter trips; office-anchored after-work and lunchtime retail demand erodes faster than transit recovery adds, so RETAIL_REC falls over the next week.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES week-on-week change is negative while TRANSIT week-on-week change is positive
evidence_refs: fact:in the final snapshot week WORKPLACES fell 0.9 points to -32.6 while TRANSIT rose 1.0 point to -41.3
failure_condition: In weeks where WORKPLACES falls while TRANSIT rises, the following 7-day mean of RETAIL_REC is equal to or higher than the preceding 7-day mean in more than half of observations.
